correctness.rationale: Integrated the exact endpoint kernel: with r=a/b,s=c/b,w=(z/b)^2, the numerator is Aw^2+Bw+C, A=1-r+s, B=(1-r)(r-s^2)-s(r^2+1), C=rs(r-(1-r)s)>0. Its discriminant factors as -(1-r)(r-s)(1+s)Q_r(s), Q_r(s)=(1-r)s^2+(r^2+6r+1)s-r(1-r). Q increases strictly with a single root in (0,r); B>0 on the nonnegative-discriminant branch. The pole locations cannot cancel. Mapping the two w-roots by square roots proves the complete upper-plane classification, holomorphic multiplicities, and square-root opening. Independent SymPy checks confirmed rational identity, discriminant, two-interval polynomial and exact (r,s)=(2/5,1/15) collision and prefactor squared 91/100. One/two bands permit zero/one upper zeros respectively. This is an algebraic all-parameter proof, not a numerical extrapolation.
